title: Make the Theming token table demonstrate the live site theme
remediation: cycle-2 re-bound the evidence to the committed tip 2e92789 after cycle-1 review flagged stale hashes (three files edited post-capture) and unrecorded preview ownership.

preview_listener.verified: listener PID/cwd confirmed BEFORE the three verifies and UNCHANGED AFTER — the runs reused this owned preview, never a foreign one.

browser.explicit_contexts: each case creates its own browser.newContext with explicit colorScheme and javaScriptEnabled, so the identical path runs under every project (the ORI-AST-002 convention).

build.note: the static /docs/theming route binds ORI-CONT-002's theming.mdx via render(entry) + <Content components={{ TokenTable }} />; the table renders 20 paired rows with both value columns in the static HTML.

typecheck.note: root tsc --noEmit (tests/**/*.ts + scripts/**/*.ts) + registry typecheck both exit 0; the spec evaluate bodies are string expressions so the no-DOM-lib tsconfig never sees browser globals.

design_notes.component_binding: Astro's render(entry) + <Content components={{ TokenTable }} /> is the render-time binding the manuscript's bare <TokenTable /> needs; the catch-all excludes the reserved theming slug, so the static route is the single destination.
design_notes.value_vs_metadata: values come only from the real global.css :root/html.light declarations (parseCssVariables anchored at line-start so prose mentions of html.light/:root never match a comment); usage labels + DOCS-ONLY classification come only from token-usage.json (which carries zero oklch/hsl literals).
design_notes.computed_current_value: the current-value cell reads its sibling swatch's resolved backgroundColor (background: var(--token)), which serializes as the same oklch number form the static columns print — getPropertyValue re-serializes as percentages and would disagree with the sheet text.
design_notes.dark_marker: theme-toggle.ts now flips both html.light and html.dark in the one click transition; the DocsLayout MutationObserver remains redundant-but-consistent (both derive dark = !light).
design_notes.reconnect: refreshTokenValues() runs on every connectedCallback and every click; a ClientRouter swap upgrades a fresh island so the freshly-inserted TokenTable cells re-populate with no duplicate listener and no sixth custom element.
